# AI Hidden Leads

> AI Hidden Leads provides Aspen, an AI receptionist with a live video avatar. Aspen answers a business's phone calls and website visitors 24/7 — by voice and chat — answers questions from the business's own information, books appointments into its calendar, and sends the owner a summary after each call. Businesses can watch Aspen work on their own website in a free live demo that takes about 2 minutes.

## What it is

- An AI receptionist for small and midsize businesses: answers calls instantly, around the clock — nights, weekends and holidays — so callers never land in voicemail.
- Aspen can appear on the business's website as a live, lip-synced video avatar (an AI spokesperson) while she talks with visitors by voice and chat. The avatar is an optional add-on; the voice receptionist works on its own.
- She books appointments, sends confirmations and reminders, and can transfer a caller to the owner when a human is needed.
- Plans also include website chat and B2B prospect generation (weekly batches of prospects; counts vary by market and no specific count is guaranteed).

## Pricing

- Premium: $99/mo — 400 voice minutes, website chat, up to 50 B2B prospects per month.
- Professional: $199/mo — 1,200 voice minutes, up to 100 prospects per month.
- Platinum: $349/mo — 2,500 voice minutes, up to 200 prospects per month.
- Live video avatar add-on: $79/mo on any plan (first month free).
- The $199 setup fee is waived through the end of the month.
